Qualifications

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated history of Developing software applications (can be during an internship or personal projects) Creative thinking and problem-solving Meeting deadlines in fast-paced goal-oriented environment Collaborating effectively within a team to achieve a goal/objective

Required Experience with object-oriented programming in Python

Desired UI/UX experience Experience with database systems such as SQL and Oracle Blazor and Telerik experience Azure experience Experience with statistical modeling Agile development experience QT Framework and/or .NET framework experience

Education & Experience Requirements 0-3 years of relevant professional experience Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field (e.g. Computer Science Engineering Applied Mathematics Data Analytics Statistics etc.) or equivalent experience Must be able to obtain and maintain Secret level clearance
